name: MazeGenerator
src_typeComment: Recursive-backtracker maze generation — a REFERENCE/SKELETON implementation, not a fully generalized plug-and-play tool (intentionally minimal: grid size + seed are the only knobs). Produces a "perfect" maze (exactly one path between any two cells, no loops, no isolated areas). Consume the output by checking each cell's MazeWalls flags to decide where to place wall geometry/colliders, e.g.:  MazeWalls[,] maze = MazeGenerator.Generate(10, 10, seed: 42); if ((maze[x, y] & MazeWalls.North) != 0) /* wall present to the north — place a wall segment here */

src_members.sig: public static MazeWalls[,] Generate(int width, int height, int seed)
